title: World Bloom — To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage
meta.Outline: On MORE MORE JUMP!'s first free day in quite some time, they have been enjoying school life to the full. Their recent TV appearance has caused a buzz among their classmates, renewing their determination to keep working their hardest. That's when they each find themselves in an unfamiliar part of SEKAI...!

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Today was really fun!
It's been so long since I got to stay all day for classes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I can't let my guard down...!
We've got tests coming up, so I'll need to review what we went over today once I get home.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hi, Minori.
Are you ready to head over for our meeting today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're discussing what we're gonna do moving forward, right?! I'm so excited. It feels like it's been forever since we last met up on the rooftop♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
We've been so busy with work lately that it's been rare for all four of us to be at school together.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We have the MORE MORE HOUSE now...
But the rooftop is where everything began for us, so I'm hoping that we can keep coming back from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
Both the MORE MORE HOUSE and the rooftop mean so much to us, so...
Hey, you two!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Kaepon...!
And with most of our class!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Long time no see, you two.
We know you've been busy, but is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we're grateful that we've been getting so many offers.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You've been showing up in so many magazines, Kaepon! You looked so pretty in the latest issue of “uou-ou”.

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Along with uou-ou, I've been doing a ton of shoots for a bunch of different magazines lately.

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line:
But enough about me!
I saw you girls on “Chat A Lot About Nothing with Takashi Arimura!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, Kaepon, you watched...?!

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line:
Of course I watched!
I mean, I knew that my friends were gonna be on it!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Same here!
I still can't believe that you all got to be on such a famous person's primetime program!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Actually, we got pretty lucky there.
The group that was originally slated to go on had to cancel suddenly, and we were asked to fill in for them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The producer just happened to be someone we had worked with earlier, and they were kind enough to give us a chance.

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line:
Wow, really...?!
I guess it goes to show how important it is to have connections!

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line: Anyway, I loved it, and I doubt it could've gone better! I even overheard some girls talking about it when I stopped by the school store earlier.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, this might be the biggest response we've gotten so far.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Our name recognition's really been going up, so moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, look at the time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sorry, everyone!
We've gotta get to a meeting...!

rows.Speaker: Kaepon
rows.Line:
Actually, I've gotta run to the studio too!
Sorry, I didn't mean to keep you two like this.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
But I'm really glad we got to talk.
Tell us more when you have some more free time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We will.
Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, shall we head up to the rooftop?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That was a nice boost of encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So we gotta keep doing our best!
Several dozen minutes later
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've all had a chance to report on our activities, I'd like for us to start discussing stream ideas next. But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I still can't believe how much everyone's been talking about that show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, you feel the same way...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We actually just got to chat with our classmates about it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: While walking through the courtyard, I had some girls call out to me and say, “We loved that show! We're rooting for you!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Some girls I haven't had a chance to talk to lately even sent me messages saying how they saw us on that show...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's so nice to see how we're able to reach more people than ever now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like we all feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, we have to thank our lucky stars for getting a chance to appear on that show. There's no guarantee that we're going to keep receiving such big offers...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, there's no arguing that we've reached a turning point.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A turning point...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. On top of us rising up the trend charts, we've been getting more and more new people following us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This means we'll need to consider their needs with regards to our streams since they're just starting to get to know us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, for our next stream, should we come up with ways to tell our new viewers what we're doing and such...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but we shouldn't focus all our attention on them. Doing so would lead to us alienating our existing followers...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, let's introduce ourselves to our new viewers while also doing something fun that our existing ones will enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I haven't actually thought it all the way through...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Big swing and a miss.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I think I understand what Minori's trying to say.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We should try putting on streams that all our viewers old and new can enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It won't be easy, but let's start coming up with ideas along those lines.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we're just about out of time, so let's end today's meeting here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I have to be somewhere after this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll be having our next meeting at the MORE MORE HOUSE tomorrow, so let's keep thinking about what we talked about today until then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah... I'm hoping that we'll be able to get the ball rolling once we've got a few ideas under our belt.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Coming up with good stream ideas is really hard, but I promise to do my best again this time around...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll also do my best to come up with something good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, this meeting's adjourned!
See you all tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, see you!

Several dozen minutes later
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's been a while since I've been able to go to school lately...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I'm really glad I did because we get to walk home together like this, Ayumi!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too!
I'm glad we bumped into each other just as club activities were ending! Talk about perfect timing!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I've been aching to talk to you about your appearance on Arimura's show the other day!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: I really loved it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You did?!
That means a lot coming from you.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: A lot of people I know have also been talking about it! Especially the fashion check segment!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: That show sometimes brings professional athletes and famous authors in as guests, which caters to a fairly wide demographic. So a lot of people who don't know much about idols watch.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seems that way. Recently, some people have even been saying that they've started tuning into our streams after seeing that show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And they really didn't seem like the type of people who follow idols based on their profiles.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
To think that so many different people have learned about who we are and gained an interest in us...
It kinda reminded me of how powerful TV is...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
TV has helped a lot of celebrities turn into household names overnight.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But I think they all gained an interest in your group because you've been working so hard.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Including me! You were on fire during that fashion check segment! It made me want to see you do more of those kinds of things now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ayumi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks...!
Variety shows like that are sorta my strong suit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can't say for sure if we'll get to be on another one anytime soon, but if that's what people want...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Huh? Is someone calling you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, it's our manager.
Mind if I take this?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Yeah, sure.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry...
Hey, what's up?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<Hi, good news!
I just received an offer asking for you, Airi.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, that's great!
Can you tell me more?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <You're being asked to appear on a variety show. It's only available for viewing online, but it's actually very popular...>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <Most of the people who appear on it are comedians since it usually involves a lot of pranks and unexpected occurrences.>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <I know you were on a lot of these kinds of shows when you were still with QT, but this would be your first time as a member of MORE MORE JUMP!, right?>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <This show sort of hearkens back to that time, which likely means doing some over-the-top stuff, but...>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<What do you think?
You do appear to be free when they need you, but the final call is yours.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, I accept!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know they want me to that sort of variety-show spectacle, but my goal will still be to spread hope to as many people as I can.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Plus, there's no reason for me to refuse this offer if it can help increase our group's name recognition!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, please tell them that I happily accept and promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
<Understood.
Then, I'll let them know right away!>

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: <I'll let you know during our meeting tomorrow after I receive more details regarding the show.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Did you just get a new offer...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I did.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Wow, really...?!
That's great...!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But you said something about being a variety-show spectacle...? Does that mean you're going to be on another...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can't give you any details, but that appears to be the case.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Cool...!
I always loved seeing you on variety shows because of the energy you brought to the table, so I'll be looking forward to this one!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Unlike the others, I'm not really a pure idol, so I've gotta make contributions where I can.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I promise to make my next appearance another good one, so stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... O-Okay.
Again, I'll be looking forward to it...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But what you just said about not being a pure idol...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What did you just...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa, that was close!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What's that driver thinking...?!
Why are they going so fast on such a narrow street?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
I know, right?
Especially considering how a lot of students use this street.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, we've already come this far.
You keep going straight here, right, Ayumi?

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah...
And you're that way, so I guess this is where we'll part for today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but I'm glad we had a chance to talk. It's been too long.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's do this again the next chance we get!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
Okay!
Today was sort of a coincidence, but let's actually plan for it next time!

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Let me know when you think we'll be able to!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, for sure!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Oh, wait...
I forgot to ask Ayumi what she was trying to say just now.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I guess I can do that the next time I see her...)
Several dozen minutes later
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Today turned out pretty well, especially since I got to talk to Ayumi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know school's about studying and stuff, but seeing my friends always puts a smile on my face...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, I don't have time to get all sentimental right now. I've gotta start coming up with stream ideas for tomorrow's meeting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Something that our new and existing viewers will both enjoy, huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hmm...
This is a lot harder than usual.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What if we split it into two parts?
The first half would be for our newcomers, and the latter half for everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, that might not be such a good idea.
We'd essentially be forcing them to choose between one or the other.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What else can we do...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come to think of it, every VIRTUAL SINGER show I've seen so far has been really good...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is there some secret behind their success...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, why am I asking myself that?
I should just go over to SEKAI and ask them myself!
bgm_area00002

Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hmm...?
Something's wrong. I'm not seeing any of them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Normally, I'd run into at least one of them. Maybe they're practicing backstage or something...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Has this path always been here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, I don't think so...
It's right out in the open, so we'd have noticed. Where does it lead to...?
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Wait a second...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-What is this place...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-What is this place...?
Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Your timing couldn't have been better...!
I was about to go tell the others that a new area just appeared in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Len...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I knew it. This place wasn't always here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But why now all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I don't really know either.
But you've gotta remember that this SEKAI is a reflection of you and the others' feelings...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which means this area must've appeared as a result of something having changed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: With our feelings...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But what's changed...?
I can't think of anything off the top of my head...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I dunno either...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So why don't we try exploring this place to see if we can learn more about it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There might be some clues scattered around as to why it appeared.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's try going for a little walk.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We've been walking for a while now...
But it's like there's no end to this field of flowers.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's like there's no other side.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Regardless, this place is beautiful.
A lot of these flowers are still just buds, some are starting to bloom. And the air feels great.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As strange as this place is, I can't help but smile. I feel happy for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah... In that sense, it's like when we're watching you girls put on a show or make an appearance on TV.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of TV...
You were able to go to school for the whole day for the first time in a while, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
How was it?
Did you get to hear from your classmates about how your last appearance went?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we weren't expecting to get such a huge response! It's probably our biggest yet, which had made us really happy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only that, but I received a new offer while walking home from school!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
What does it involve?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Appearing on a variety show with a bunch of comedians. It's apparently one of those programs where anything goes, but I'm excited since it'll be my first solo gig in a while...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, that's awesome!
I'll be looking forward to seeing it since that sort of stuff is your forte.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know that idols aren't really supposed to fall into booby traps or jump into ponds, but I plan on doing everything I can...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This flower... Look, it's glowing for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But there are plenty of other ones that are blooming. Why only this one...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I don't understand either.
But what if I touched it...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
...?!
The light from this flower's...

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: A-Airi?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Where am I...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's weird.
I was with Len just a second ago...
Th-Thank you for coming today, Happy Everyday!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, that voice...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whenever you feel down and out, come and see me! I'll help cheer you up and see how wonderful tomorrow is going to be!

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line:
Okay!
Thanks, Happy Everyday!

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: I really like you as an idol too! You're the best, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This is from...
When we went put on an event at that elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But what's that got to do with...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: I'm saying this because I've been looking up to you ever since we were still in training.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're one of my favorite idols, Airi, as well as my role model...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You've been that ever since the day we met...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And this is from...
When we held that training camp.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-What's going on here...?

rows.Speaker: Woman's Voice
rows.Line: Airi's so good at interacting with crowds!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And this is... The venue where we held our first fan event. But I don't recall hearing that comment...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why am I seeing...?

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Her quips are always spot on, and she makes the best reactions. I guess this is when her experience as Happy Everyday comes in handy.

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line:
Yeah, probably.
I mean, Airi is more of a variety show star than an idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I still haven't jumped back into the deep end in terms of variety shows as a member of MORE MORE JUMP! yet...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I guess that's still how most people typecast me.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Which sort of means that I should make the most of my talents and...)

rows.Speaker: Woman C
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
I've always seen Airi as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Woman C
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm new and don't know what Airi was like when she was still with QT. But based on her behavior, it's clear that she just wants to cheer everybody up and make them smile...

rows.Speaker: Woman C
rows.Line: The way she interacts with people and reacts is proof of that. And that's...

rows.Speaker: Woman C
rows.Line:
That's what I really love about her.
That's why I see her as a pure idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I forgot...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I was so happy when people said that they like me as both Happy Everyday and an idol...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Which is why...
I made the decision to accept both sides of who I am as an idol, and do my best...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But somewhere along the way, I must've convinced myself that I had to choose one or the other...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh...!
The light's starting to fade...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Airi?
You were engulfed by that light and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now I see...
You didn't see any of what just happened, did you, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It was so strange...
While I was in that light, it was like I was looking into someone's memories.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I realized that I was needlessly drawing lines in the sand for myself...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Lines?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I spent so much time doing variety shows that I thought I had to keep appearing on them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd make the most of my talents on those, while having Shizuku and the others take the spotlight as actual idols.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I realized just now that I don't have to choose one or the other.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because there are people out there who like seeing me do both of those things.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Either way, I'm still an idol.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It doesn't matter how you do it. As long as you're doing your best to spread hope to others, then you're still an idol, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're always doing your best as a singer, dancer and an enthusiastic guest on variety shows.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's why I admire you so much as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Ayumi said...)

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But what you just said about not being a pure idol...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She might've been trying to tell me that I was getting the wrong idea.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, Len.
I feel a lot better now after hearing what you just said. Also...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm kicking myself for jumping to such a foolish conclusion while knowing that plenty of people have been supporting me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I feel like you're gonna become an even greater idol now after making that realization.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I am!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's not going to matter where I work.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <I saw the show you were on via that station's streaming service. I've actually been feeling kind of down after something that happened recently...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<But seeing you really cheered me up.
That's why I'm sending you this message. To thank you.>
...is what she wrote!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's so wonderful.
Even though she's overseas, she was still able to see us on that show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, also...
It sounds like you were able to give her just the encouragement she was looking for, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm so happy for you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hearing from her like this also makes me really happy!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, here comes the not-rain again...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Look!
Those flower buds are blooming now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, you're right...!
Do you think it's because of the rain?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What if these raindrops represent all the hope you've spread to others, or the thoughts and feelings of all those people...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I can't say for certain...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I have a feeling that it started raining because Minori was able to cheer Chi up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And this flower is a symbol of hope because it's being watered by this rain...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In other words, spreading hope to Chi caused this flower to bloom.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I have to agree.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
This rain has this warmth to it.
The kind of warmth I feel whenever I'm watching you girls perform on stage.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If these flowers represent everyone's thoughts and feelings, then it makes sense how touching them allows you to see what they're thinking.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure the reason why they're this beautiful is because they've been nurtured by your gentle warmth.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. What a lovely thought.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which means, to borrow what KAITO just said, we can call these “flowers of hope”.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Flowers of hope...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I really like that!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But this field...
Most of the flowers in it are still just buds.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which means it's going to look incredibly beautiful once they've all bloomed. Imagine all the colors we're going to see.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: All the colors...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's it...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I just realized something amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Amazing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
See that stage over there?
I just realized that the view from up there would look a lot like...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A lot like the glowsticks everyone's going to be waving around when we do our show at the Dome!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, this place appeared because we were able to come up with a concrete goal for ourselves and it's a sign of us making progress toward achieving it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Dunno...
But by the time all the flowers here are in full bloom...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We might be at a point in our careers as idols where we can actually do a show at the Dome.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We gotta keep doing our best.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We gotta keep spreading hope to everyone, make all these flowers bloom...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And do a show at the Dome someday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When we do, we'll get to see a big, beautiful field of glowsticks waving around!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, let's keep doing our best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (MORE MORE JUMP! is such an incredible group.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Initially, everything had come to a standstill for them. They were all broken, bruised or scarred in some way...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But they were all able to connect around the idea of spreading and inspiring hope in others. That's what allowed them to stand back up and pursue their dreams.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And now, they're beginning to spread hope to the wider masses.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, with that out of the way, we need to start polishing our stream ideas for tomorrow's meeting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Fortunately, I feel like I know what I want to do now after getting a chance to see everyone's thoughts...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Me too...
I have a good feeling about the ideas I'll be bringing with me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to hearing what you all came up with tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh...?
What's this...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's what?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This...
It looks like a little sprout.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
And it looks a bit different from all the flowers around here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that this sprout will get bigger and bigger alongside you girls.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
In that sense...
I'm looking forward to seeing how it grows.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right.
I'm already getting excited about seeing what kind of flower it blossoms into!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We can't say for sure that it's going to turn into a flower.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We'll just have to stay tuned to find out.
In any case, we're going to do everything we can to make all the flowers in the field bloom!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, so that we get to perform at the Dome someday! Ready, everyone?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MORE MORE...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Airi & Haruka
rows.Line: JUMP!
